Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s [All Turns] effect activate when a security card is removed from my security stack by one of my own effects?
After gaining  from this card's [All Turns] effect during my opponent's turn, can this Digimon gain  again from this card's [All Turns] effect during my next turn?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. This effect is triggered "when a card is removed from your opponent's security stack," so even when you check multiple cards in your opponent's security stack, it is triggered and activates upon the first check. Also, this is a [Once Per Turn] effect, so this effect activates when a card is removed from their security stack upon the first check, and you can't activate the effect again upon the next check.

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn’t activate. The effect triggers when a card is removed from a security stack, but this card is removed from the battle area before it can activate.
